observations.summary: 16 Vitest cases and 2 real-browser cases pass; typecheck, lint, naming, build, static Inspector and update guidance pass. Screenshots inspected at 1082 x 672; user visual acceptance remains pending. Build retains an existing shared-bundle size warning.

Incomplete. Pantry east parapet and flat rear end are live; 21 earlier structural cases, 8 projection/exterior cases, app type/lint/naming, and 7 actual-app capture cases passed. Source/app crops plus above/rear views were inspected; exterior digest unchanged. Owner then identified wrong west-divider topology. New actual near/distant same-plane/ordered-members regression is red. Two full constrained candidates failed and were not applied. Offline foot ablation keeps 21 marks within retained limits but leaves the source foot 73.203 px away; this diagnostic is not live and is not proof of source impossibility. Direction requested before changing visible proportions in a separate structural correction drawing. The original target is preserved. Whole-building room proportions and source fidelity remain unaccepted; shadow banding deferred. No commit or push.

notes.text: 2026-10-26: Owner-approved building structure applied through normal app composition. Forty focused structure tests, two exterior/crown cases, typecheck/build, lint, 15 naming checks and one hardware-browser case pass. Overview and enlarged 964x902 captures inspected; current IAB reloaded and inspected. Evidence: assets/asyra-office/models/architecture/review/live-approved-structure-overview.png, live-approved-structure-close.png and live-approved-structure-record.json. Frozen approved snapshot SHA d86f7e7b55db77a90a75bf4ff7449581d8cd53c0aa58753722a89c93b239cd5d. Earlier green-depth/parapet report describes the superseded source revision. Full scene criterion is not cleared by this bounded structural milestone; furnishings, lighting banding and full product validation remain deferred. No commit or push.
